test.title: A tax on sugary food and drinks

document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: Rising rates of obesity, diabetes and tooth decay have led many governments to consider taxing products that contain large amounts of sugar. I largely agree that such a tax is a sensible measure, although it will only be effective if it forms part of a wider public health strategy.

The strongest argument for a sugar tax is that price has a direct influence on what people buy. Soft drinks are cheap and heavily advertised, and many consumers, especially teenagers, drink several cans a day without considering the health consequences. When prices rise, even modestly, sales tend to fall, and manufacturers often respond by reducing the sugar content of their products to avoid the tax. In the United Kingdom, for example, many companies changed the recipes of their drinks before the levy was even introduced. A further benefit is that the money raised can be spent on health education or sports facilities for young people.

However, critics point out that such taxes place a heavier burden on poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on food. They also argue that adults should be free to make their own choices. These concerns are valid, but I do not think they outweigh the potential benefits. Poorer communities also suffer most from diet-related illnesses, so they stand to gain the most if consumption falls, and the tax does not ban anything; it simply makes the true cost of unhealthy products more visible.

In conclusion, I agree that governments should tax sugary food and drinks, as higher prices discourage excessive consumption and encourage producers to make healthier products. Nevertheless, a tax alone cannot solve the problem, so it should be combined with clearer food labelling and better education about nutrition.

note.en: A reservation in the thesis: the agreement is not complete.
note.ru: Оговорка в тезисе: согласие не полное.

note.en: Opens the paragraph with the strongest point.
note.ru: Открывает абзац с самого сильного довода.

note.en: Singles out the group most affected.
note.kk: Мәселе ең көп қатысты топты ерекшелейді.
note.ru: Выделяет группу, которой проблема касается больше всего.

note.en: Condition and result: prices rise → sales fall.
note.kk: Шарт пен нәтиже: баға өседі → сатылым азаяды.
note.ru: Условие и результат: цена растёт → продажи падают.

note.en: A real example supporting the point.
Accepts the objection and answers it immediately.
note.ru: Признаёт возражение и тут же отвечает на него.

note.en: Brings back the reservation from the introduction.

strengths.en: The degree of agreement is stated precisely — “largely”, which is exactly what “To what extent” asks for.
strengths.kk: Келісім дәрежесі дәл аталған — «негізінен». «To what extent» дәл осыны сұрайды.
strengths.ru: Степень согласия названа точно — «в основном». Именно это спрашивает «To what extent».
strengths.example: I largely agree that such a tax is a sensible measure

strengths.en: The point is supported by a real fact rather than general statements.
strengths.kk: Дәлел жалпы сөзбен емес, өмірдегі деректермен бекітілген.
strengths.ru: Довод подкреплён фактом из жизни, а не общими словами.
strengths.example: many companies changed the recipes of their drinks before the levy was even introduced

strengths.en: The writer does not ignore the objections but deals with them — this is what separates band 8 from band 6.
strengths.kk: Автор қарсылықтарды елемей қоймай, оларды талдайды — band 8-ді band 6-дан осы ажыратады.
strengths.ru: Автор не игнорирует возражения, а разбирает их — это отличает band 8 от band 6.
strengths.example: These concerns are valid, but I do not think they outweigh the potential benefits

strengths.en: A relative clause adds an explanation without an extra sentence.
strengths.kk: Анықтауыш бағыныңқы сөйлем артық сөйлемсіз түсіндірме қосады.
strengths.ru: Определительное придаточное добавляет объяснение без лишнего предложения.
strengths.example: which spend a larger share of their income on food

note.en: Introduction: the background and a position of “largely agree” with a reservation that returns in the conclusion.
note.kk: Кіріспе: мәселенің аясы және «негізінен келісемін» деген ұстаным — ескертпесі қорытындыда қайта шығады.
note.ru: Введение: фон проблемы и позиция «в основном согласен» с оговоркой, которая вернётся в выводе.

note.en: Arguments for: price changes behaviour, producers change recipes, the money funds health. There is a real example.
note.kk: «Жақтайтын» дәлелдер: баға мінез-құлықты өзгертеді, өндірушілер құрамын өзгертеді, ақша денсаулыққа жұмсалады. Нақты мысал бар.
note.ru: Доводы «за»: цена меняет поведение, производители меняют рецептуру, деньги идут на здоровье. Есть реальный пример.

note.en: Counter-arguments and a reply: the writer accepts the objections but explains why they do not change the position.
note.kk: Қарсы дәлелдер және оларға жауап: автор қарсылықтарды мойындайды, бірақ ұстанымды неге өзгертпейтінін түсіндіреді.
note.ru: Контраргументы и ответ на них: автор признаёт возражения, но объясняет, почему они не меняют позицию.

note.en: The conclusion restates the position and the reservation in different words.
note.kk: Қорытынды ұстаным мен ескертпені басқа сөзбен қайталайды.
note.ru: Вывод повторяет позицию и оговорку другими словами.

document.title: A tax on sugary food and drinks
document.question:
Some people believe that governments should put a special tax on sugary food and drinks in order to improve public health.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
